bias_targets.methodology: Practitioners evaluate model performance across different skin tones, races, and ethnicities by testing dataset representation, using A/B testing, and employing data manipulation and simulation tools (like GANs) to generate synthetic examples for underrepresented groups.

Evaluated by ensuring training data is representative and balanced across different genders, and applying well-defined metrics (such as accuracy, precision, and recall) to detect performance disparities between gender groups.

Measured by testing AI systems (such as computer vision and sign language translation models) using examples of people with reduced mobility and other physical conditions to ensure fair inclusion and recognition.

Addressed by auditing data representation and balancing to ensure AI systems treat all demographic and socioeconomic groups equitably, often utilizing GPT-based models and data detox techniques to avoid exclusion patterns.
